messages:
raj: spotted a burst of apiserver 5xx in eu-west1 at ~09:33, controller-manager leader keep flipping and several attach failures for GPU pods. KV cache eviction events line up with NAT conntrack spikes.

maria-sre: confirming, apiserver p95 latency jumped to ~1.2s and then a flurry of 503s. controller-manager logs show repeated List calls failing with EOF.

deploy-bot: rollout change: blue-proxy v3.0.0 deployed to eu-west1 by kevin at 09:30 (sha: d4e5f6).

kevin: that rollout enabled an experimental tcp_keepalive tweak to reduce idle timeouts, also bumped worker threads from 50->150. rolling back now.

raj: sample from apiserver logs ->
```
W0908 09:33:12.987 apiserver cache.go:412] kvcache: eviction storm: resource=pods ns=prod
E0908 09:33:13.012 transport.go:180] http2: server handler error: read tcp 10.20.30.40:443->10.1.2.3:53412: connection reset by peer
```

maria-sre: NAT metrics show conntrack table near max, SYN_RECV backlog high. I think the proxy threads multiplied outbound connections and exhausted ephemeral ports.

oncall: mitigation plan: 1) rollback proxy to v2.9.9 (in progress) 2) temporarily scale apiserver from 3->6 replicas 3) bump nf_conntrack_max and shorten TIME_WAIT reuse windows on eu-west1 NATs. I'll execute 1&2 now.

kevin: rollback started, should finish in ~2m.

raj: note controller-manager leader transitions: leader lease renews failing, controllers requeueing and spiking list calls. Could cause pod assignment delays and GPU attach backlog.

maria-sre: adding small tweak: increase controller-manager leader-elect lease-duration to 45s (from 15s) while we stabilize to reduce thrash. Will revert after incident.

oncall: rolled apiserver to 6 replicas and applied conntrack bump to 200000. Keepalive revert applied.

kevin: rollback complete, proxy v2.9.9 serving. monitoring.

raj: conntrack counts dropping, apiserver 503s trending to zero, controller-manager leader stabilized. GPU attach backlog still at ~150 queued, but attach success rate improving.

tara: finance ping — how long might partial GPU waste last?

raj: rough calc: 150 GPUs * $0.08/min * 60 = ~$720/hr until backlog clears. Will capture exact duration and update.

maria-sre: next actions: 1) add rollout preflight that simulates connection fanout (kevin) 2) add conntrack saturation alert on NAT dashboards (raj) 3) run staging soak with keepalive variation (sam) 4) revert controller-manager lease tweak after 24h (maria-sre).

finance-bot: created ticket FIN-1122 to track estimated incremental cost.

kevin: i'll write the rollback playbook and add conntrack check to CI.

raj: creating incident INC-2026-211 and assigning oncall. please add timeline to doc. nice triage everyone, closing thread once incident page has initial cost and postmortem owners. :thumbsup:
